preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 300,000.
The number of edges in the graph is between n-1 and 300,000.
Each vertex has an integer di which can be -1, 0, or 1.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected.

postconditions.description: If no good subset of edges exists, output -1.
If a good subset exists, output the number of edges k in the subset.
If a good subset exists, output the indices of the edges in the subset.
If a good subset exists, the output should be deterministic, meaning the same input will always produce the same output.
